description.title: טופס תביעה להחזר הוצאות סיעוד - כללית
description.summary: This table describes the requirements for submitting a nursing care claim for Clalit members. It details the documentation needed, such as permits for foreign workers or affidavits from caregivers, and how compensation is adjusted for stays in nursing institutions.
description.embed_passage: טופס זה מיועד להגשת תביעה להחזר הוצאות סיעוד לחברי כללית. לצורך טיפול מהיר בתביעה, יש לצרף אישורים מתאימים, כגון היתר להעסקת עובד זר או תצהיר ממשפחה/ מטפל. במקרה של שהות במוסד סיעודי, יש לספק קבלות חודשיות על תשלום למוסד, ועד לקבלתן, הפיצוי ישולם כאילו המבוטח מתגורר בבית. מסמכים רפואיים, חוות דעת מומחים, מכתבי שחרור מבית חולים, תוצאות בדיקות (כולל חוות דעת מרופא/ת אורולוגיה/ פרוקטולוגיה/ גסטרואנטרולוגיה במקרה של בריחת שתן), אבחנות ואישורים המעידים על מצב תפקודי ו/או קוגניטיבי יכולים לסייע בטיפול בתביעה. טופס תביעה להחזר הוצאות סיעוד, עובד זר, תצהיר, מוסד סיעודי, קבלות, חוות דעת רפואית.
notable_values: Receipts for nursing institution: required for accurate payment
Home residence assumption: used until receipts are provided

sketch:
The certificate/ affidavit wording is attached to this claim form.
In respect of an insured in nursing condition who resides in a nursing institution, where the stay in the nursing institution affects the extent of compensation under the policy, current monthly receipts should be provided regarding actual payment to the institution for the purpose of realizing the eligibility. Until the receipts are obtained as aforementioned, compensation will be paid as if the insured resides at home. Insofar as receipts are provided retrospectively, the compensation will be adjusted for the period during which the insured was actually in the institution, less the monies paid and all subject to the policy conditions.
In order to streamline handling of your claim and to the extent that you are in possession of medical documents, expert doctor opinions, hospitalization or hospital discharge letters, test results including an opinion by a urologist/ proctologist/ gastroenterologist in the event of diagnosis regarding incontinence, diagnoses and confrmations indicating your functional and/or cognitive condition, you may forward the documents to us.

טבלה: טופס תביעה להחזר הוצאות סיעוד - כללית
This table describes the requirements for submitting a nursing care claim for Clalit members. It details the documentation needed, such as permits for foreign workers or affidavits from caregivers, and how compensation is adjusted for stays in nursing institutions.
ממדים: Claim requirement / documentation type, Details / conditions for submission

The certificate/ affidavit wording is attached to this claim form.
In respect of an insured in nursing condition who resides in a nursing institution, where the stay in the nursing institution affects the extent of compensation under the policy, current monthly receipts should be provided regarding actual payment to the institution for the purpose of realizing the eligibility. Until the receipts are obtained as aforementioned, compensation will be paid as if the insured resides at home. Insofar as receipts are provided retrospectively, the compensation will be adjusted for the period during which the insured was actually in the institution, less the monies paid and all subject to the policy conditions.
In order to streamline handling of your claim and to the extent that you are in possession of medical documents, expert doctor opinions, hospitalization or hospital discharge letters, test results including an opinion by a urologist/ proctologist/ gastroenterologist in the event of diagnosis regarding incontinence, diagnoses and confrmations indicating your functional and/or cognitive condition, you may forward the documents to us.
